If an element is divisible by 13, it can be written as \( 13m \) for some integer \( m \). Therefore, having more than one element divisible by 13 would violate the condition that the sum of any three elements is not divisible by 13.

Thus, the maximum number of elements in \( S \) that can be divisible by 13 is 1.
